Class IuJsonbGenerator

java.lang.Object
iu.client.jsonb.IuJsonbGenerator
All Implemented Interfaces:
JsonGenerator, Closeable, Flushable, AutoCloseable
final class IuJsonbGenerator extends Object implements JsonGenerator
Builds the JsonValue described by JsonGenerator calls, so a JsonbSerializer can run in a tree conversion.

Follows the JsonGenerator contract for a single value: calls out of context throw JsonGenerationException, as does a second value, or close() before the value is complete. As in any JsonObject, a name written twice in the same object keeps its last value.
